variant_definitions.noise_factor: dataset/imaging/hst/noise_map.fits multiplied by the factor, then loaded / masked (3.5 arcsec) / over-sampled (4/2/2) exactly as mge_nnls_capture._dataset. q and the curvature matrix scale by 1/factor**2 but the unregularised-column diagonal shift (no_regularization_add_to_curvature_diag_value = 1e-3, all 60 columns) does not: Q = C/factor**2 + 1e-3 I, so max|q| and cond(Q) both move by ~1/factor**2 and the reference solution changes.
